criteria_verification.criterion_text: `_ensure_roles_registered()` is idempotent (calling it twice does not raise or duplicate-register).
criteria_verification.evidence: _ensure_roles_registered is double-guarded: (1) a module-level boolean _ROLES_REGISTERED short-circuits subsequent calls, (2) the underlying register_role call returns the existing entry (no duplicate, no exception) when re-invoked with an identical mapping. A threading.Lock prevents concurrent first-call races from running registration twice.
